voice_instructions: Measured, quiet, a little hushed — calm and unhurried, but with a touch more forward energy than a long documentary; the cold voice of something that read the whole file. Never sensational. Small pauses.

beats.vo: Lake Bodom, Finland. June, nineteen sixty. Four teenagers pitched a tent on the shore for the night.
In the early morning, someone attacked the tent from outside. Three of them were killed. One survived.
The weapons were never found. Keys to the motorcycles were missing. The motorcycles were left behind.
In two thousand four, police arrested the survivor. In two thousand five, a court acquitted him.
No one has ever been convicted. More than sixty years on, the killer has never been identified.
